title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 21: the sword drawn out of its sheath, the king of Babylon at the parting of the ways, and the word against Ammon.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will draw out of its sheath?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, 'Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath.'

questions.text: Whom would the sword cut off from the land of Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will cut off from them both the righteous and the wicked, and his sword will go out against all flesh from the south to the north.

answers.text: Both the righteous and the wicked
Only the foreigners in the land

questions.text: What was the prophet to answer when they asked why he sighed?
questions.explanation: He was to sigh with a broken heart, and to say, 'Because of the news, for it comes!'

answers.text: Because of the famine in the city
Because of the news, for it comes

questions.text: How is the sword described in verse 9?
questions.explanation: The word is, 'A sword! A sword! It is sharpened, and also polished.'

answers.text: Small and light in the hand

questions.text: What was the prophet told to beat?
questions.explanation: He was told to cry and wail, for the sword is on Yahweh's people and on all the princes of Israel, and therefore to beat his thigh.

questions.text: For whose sword was the prophet to appoint two ways?
questions.explanation: He was told to appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come.

answers.text: The sword of the king of Babylon
The sword of the prince of Israel
The sword of the children of Ammon

questions.text: How did the king of Babylon use divination at the parting of the way?
questions.explanation: He shook the arrows back and forth, consulted the teraphim, and looked in the liver.

answers.text: He cast lots and burned incense to his gods
He called his prophets and waited for dreams
He shook arrows, consulted the teraphim and looked in the liver
He read the stars and cast sand on the ground

questions.text: In which hand was the lot for Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams and to cast up mounds against it.

questions.text: What was the prince of Israel told to remove?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, 'Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was.'

questions.text: Concerning whom is the second word about a drawn sword, in verse 28?
questions.explanation: Yahweh speaks concerning the children of Ammon and concerning their reproach: a sword is drawn, polished for the slaughter.
